violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Foster Cooperative Atmosphere (26 TAC §746.1203(8))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Foster Cooperative Atmosphere
violation_type.typical_finding: During this investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not foster a cooperative atmosphere and encouraged a competitive atmosphere.

finding_variants.text: During this investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not foster a cooperative atmosphere and encouraged a competitive atmosphere.
Based on the information obtained during the investigation, some caregivers are not allowing a productive, positive and friendly work environment.
There is enough evidence to support that a caregiver was telling children to hit other children back when children hit each other.
